title: Pael's Legion
description: Doubles [gold]Block[/gold] gained from a card, then goes to sleep for [blue]2[/blue] turns.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic summons a pet that participates in combat. When a card gains Block while the relic is active, the Block is doubled. The relic then enters a cooldown state (displayed as a counter) for 2 turns. During cooldown, Block doubling is disabled. The pet has multiple animation states: BlockTrigger (when Block is doubled), SleepTrigger (during cooldown after triggering), and WakeUpTrigger (when cooldown expires). The relic can be customized with different pet skins (eyes, horns, spikes, or wings).
